name: Monarchic
description: Presents Monarchic as an independent AI research and development company building AI engineering systems, with its current products, published research, and web application clearly separated beneath that company story.
copyRules: Name the mechanism, boundary, or observable result instead of using credibility adjectives.
Use procedural authentication and security language: confirm an email, name the control, and date the check.
Every interface label must communicate a fact, expose system state, or state a Monarchic operating principle; do not invent telemetry or use generic science-fiction filler.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Introduce Monarchic as an independent AI research and development company, explain the AI engineering systems it builds and why, show current work, and separate in-development products from longer-term research direction.
audience: Software developers and engineering teams using or evaluating AI-assisted development to improve intelligence, quality, speed, and reliability
Engineering leaders, AI researchers, and technical evaluators assessing system architecture, benchmark methodology, integration fit, security, and organizational adoption
Researchers, scientists, and engineers across STEM seeking reproducible automation for technical work, experimentation, and analysis
Founders, operators, and business teams seeking structured automation for creating, validating, operating, and growing businesses
Nontechnical practitioners already using AI who need dependable, guided, and repeatable workflows
requiredContent: Monarchic’s identity as a small, independent AI research and development company
A clear distinction between the company’s broad AI engineering scope and its present focus on AI agents and MCP infrastructure
A concrete explanation of the hosted tools, durable runs, scoped workers, and operator review surfaces Monarchic builds
A plain statement of Monarchic’s vision for long-running agent work with human visibility and control
A selected view of current MCP work with the full product catalog kept secondary to the company story
An ambitious but honest account of Monarchic’s maturity and operating scale
Clear paths to Products, Research, Company, and the separate Monarchic Apps workspace
Clear product lifecycle and availability boundaries
Architecture and system-design claims tied to published tests or source material
Emphasis on solving and maintaining deployed systems rather than one-shot prompt-to-app or unconstrained codebase generation
Its current commercial focus on AI systems and MCP products
Its longer-term relevance to software engineering, scientific research, and business systems without presenting future work as currently available
An explicit separation between available hosted MCPs, the in-development Monarchic workflow product, and longer-term fields of inquiry
A public record that routes research, security controls, company status, and product claims to the right supporting material
The connected-system, deterministic-tooling, and maintained-system differentiators
forbiddenContent: Hype, vague superlatives, breathless startup language, playful gimmicks, and combative competitor attacks
Unsupported superiority claims or language implying big-tech staffing or scale
All OmnisGenomics products and research until they are ready for public presentation
Presenting libmonarchic as an available or sellable product
Inventing research, benchmarks, or uniform proof sections for products without applicable evidence
Corporate-site purchasing, a dedicated contact page, or a team-centric company narrative
A services page that misrepresents MCP products as consulting services
Presenting retired ProofPack as active without a canonical lifecycle promotion
Treating PTY deployment as proof that active-development readiness gates are closed
Conflating the three evidence types
Publishing fixture-smoke, synthetic, projected, or harness-only results as full product benchmarks
Direct competitor-win claims without same-protocol comparable evidence
A top-level Solutions section before repeatable deployed outcomes and credible solution-specific evidence exist
